features.label: Wealth he never renounced
features.detail: Wrote on the vanity of riches while being one of the richest men in Rome. The gap is the interesting part, not a disqualification.

features.label: Letters, not treatises
features.detail: Philosophy addressed to one friend, which is why it reads like advice rather than doctrine.

features.label: Rehearsed his own death
features.detail: Spent decades writing about dying well, then was ordered to do it. The account of how he did is unsettling.
